name: Alpine 3.22
author: hello@soneyko.ai
description: Small persistent Alpine Linux environment with a shell and apk. Packages and files are kept in the server volume. Runs as an unprivileged PRoot guest, without a separate kernel or systemd.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.instance
echo 'Linux environment will be initialized on first start.'
